idea: Paper and ink: a warm off-white stock, near-black ink with a blue cast, and one navy that carries every interactive thing, with bronze and gold as a second voice that never acts. Fraunces on the headings is the whole typographic gesture. Formal stays still while the others move: motion commits once, as a fade, a rise or a rule that draws, and never glitches, loops or flickers.

loadBearing.claim: The ground is a warm off-white; moved to pure white, the theme becomes light.
One colour acts: navy is the only hue that means you can do something here.
No ornament: no glow, no visible texture, no flourish; the 0.375rem radius is the largest concession.
The display serif is for headings only, at its highest optical size on a surface.
Motion commits, it does not perform: every reveal is a one-shot transition and the register has no keyframes.

colourRoles.use: The page ground and the ground of a field, so an input is a ruled box on the page.
colourRoles.never: Pure white, which reads as a screen rather than a page.

colourRoles.use: A brighter stock laid on the page: cards, every panel, the navbar, the hero.
Running text, headings and field labels.

Everything that acts: the primary button, the call to action, a ghost button's label, the selected tab, the current page, a sorted column; and the two rules that close a section, the drawn heading rule and the docket tick.
colourRoles.never: Decoration unrelated to an action or a section's end.

colourRoles.use: The highlighter under a marked phrase.
colourRoles.never: A button, or any other thing that acts.

colourRoles.use: Wet ink: the mirror button's 2px offset impression and the laurels' glyphs.
colourRoles.never: A control's fill or its label.

colourRoles.use: The stamp's ink and frame, the destructive button, an invalid field's border, an error.
colourRoles.never: Emphasis that is not a warning or a stamp.

colourRoles.use: A control's boundary (a field, a ghost button), the rule under a table's header, the divider's hairline.
colourRoles.never: The quiet rule between paragraphs; that is the hairline.

colourRoles.use: The quiet content rule: card and panel frames, the navbar's bottom line, table rows.
The darker third stock: the dossier, the footer, a secondary button, a hovered menu row, the current side navigation row.

type.tracking: -0.03em on a surface headline, -0.02em on an app heading
type.description: Fraunces with its optical size at work: 144 on the headline, 90 on an app heading, 60 on card and dialog titles, 40 on the wordmark.
Instrument Sans for everything that is not a heading: text, buttons, labels, the tree, identifiers.
The microlabel is a masthead line: 0.75rem spaced capitals in navy, the only uppercase besides footer headings and the stamp.
The band and a menu's caption set in all small caps between hairlines, the way a printed running head is.
No mono voice of its own: identifiers, timestamps and URLs stay in the body face, identifiers and timestamps muted.

radius.description: 0.375rem on buttons, cards, fields and panels; 2px less on badges and tabs; 3px on the stamp. Status dots, timeline markers and the chosen day are circles and the switch is a pill.

borders.description: 1px hairlines frame cards, panels, tables and the navbar; fields and ghost buttons take the stronger rule; an empty state is a dashed rule.

shadows.description: One static letterpress impression, the mirror button's 2px gold offset with no blur, composed with the focus ring; the dropdown floats no further than an 8px/24px shadow of ink at 28 %. No glow.

signature.description: The rule. A section ends in a docket cut, a hairline with a short 4px navy tick; a heading's 2px rule draws itself once; a hovered or focused button draws a second rule 2px inside its edge, the way a certificate frames what it wants noticed.

surfaces.name: hero
surfaces.description: The hero is laid on the brighter card stock (the register paints it, over the paper its tokens name), with the headline at optical size 144.

surfaces.name: app
surfaces.description: Three stocks of the same paper: the page, a brighter card on it, and the darker muted stock of a dossier. In a light theme, raised means lighter.

surfaces.name: footer
surfaces.description: One step down, on the muted stock: spaced capital headings in the muted ink, links that underline only under the pointer.

flicker.reason: Formal commits to a line once: no glitch, no decipher, no loop. The headline stays whole from the first frame to the last, and the register holds no keyframes at all.

enter.description: The headline arrives whole: it fades up with a 6px rise, once. No character is ever replaced.
enter.reducedMotion: The headline stands at full opacity, in place.
enter.note: A menu's fade is the package's; dialogs, popovers and toasts have no entrance. See the recipe.

leave.description: A redaction is lifted: the ink over each phrase of the dossier narrows away toward the phrase's start, the way a redaction pen is dragged off a page, not a fade.
leave.duration: 260ms per phrase, staggered by --kp-redact-stagger (the register declares none, so its 80ms fallback)
leave.note: No component leaves with motion; see the recipe.

press.description: Pressing harder makes the ink darker: the package steps the fill to the pressed token, and nothing moves (--fx-lift is 0).

hover.description: The rule doubles: a second 1px rule fades in 2px inside the button's edge, navy on a light button and the label's colour on a filled one. Nothing moves.
hover.reducedMotion: The second rule appears at once.

load.description: The page sets itself once: a section's rule draws from the left when 40 % of its heading is in view, and the lede's two marks wash in left to right, 90ms apart, after 1.05s.
load.reducedMotion: The rule stands drawn and the marks stand washed: the finished look, not a degraded one.

attention.description: A notice served on the house paper. The navy plate fades in; one sheet of card stock arrives as the headline does, fading up with a 6px rise, once; the docket cut under the brick headline draws as a section rule does; the double rule 2px inside the sheet fades in as a hovered button's does; the reason fades after. Every step is a transition, nothing loops, flickers or touches a character.
attention.duration: 450ms plate and sheet; 450ms docket after 300ms; --fx-duration double rule after 450ms; 450ms reason after 250ms
attention.reducedMotion: The finished notice at once: the plate, the sheet, the drawn docket cut and the double rule.
attention.note: The alarm's colours keep their roles: navy plate and button, card stock sheet with a hairline, brick stamp capitals, ink reason, a gold impression on the button.

ornaments.name: The docket cut
ornaments.where: [data-kp-divider]; the alt divider before the footer.
ornaments.description: A full-width hairline and a 3rem navy tick 4px tall, the way a ledger marks a section closed; the alt divider is a dashed rule, quieter still.

ornaments.name: The drawn heading rule
ornaments.description: A 2px navy rule the width of the heading's box, set once.

ornaments.name: The stamp
ornaments.where: A card with a label; on the dossier, over its muted stock.
ornaments.description: Fraunces capitals in brick inside a 1.5px brick frame, rotated -3deg; the word never changes when the file is opened.

ornaments.name: The mirror impression
ornaments.description: A static 2px gold offset, a letterpress double strike; it never animates.

ornaments.name: The double rule
ornaments.where: Every button, under the pointer or the keyboard focus.
ornaments.description: A second 1px rule 2px inside the edge; the quietest of the six hover gestures, because formal is the package's default.

ornaments.name: The running head
ornaments.description: All small caps between two strong hairlines on a card-tinted ground, the slowest pass in the package (60s).

voice.case: Sentence case for headings, buttons and links; spaced capitals only for the masthead line, footer headings and the stamp; small caps for the band and menu captions.
labels: A microlabel is a masthead line in navy capitals.
A field label is the ink at weight 600, with no prefix.
The stamp reads the consumer's own label and never swaps it on reveal.
Footer links and the language link underline only under the pointer.
voice.icons: Almost none: laurel glyphs take the gold, and status dots and timeline markers are plain circles.
neverDoes: Pure white paper or pure black ink.
Bronze or gold on something that acts.
A visible texture, a glow or a rounded flourish.
Touch the headline's characters, or loop a reveal.

recipe.answer: The alarm as a notice on the house paper: a navy plate, a card stock sheet framed by the double rule, the headline in the stamp's brick capitals over the docket cut, the navy button with its gold impression; the sheet arrives, the docket draws, nothing flickers.
A plate on the card stock with a hairline and the radius; the severity toasts on the alert's token pair; the words say which severity.
The navy plate for the one action that matters, the gold impression on the decisive one; pressing darkens the ink.
The rule doubles on a button; a menu row takes the muted stock; a footer link underlines. Nothing moves.
The package's fade over --fx-duration, on the card paper with an 8px/24px ink shadow.
No entrance today: the panel is on the page at once.
recipe.proposal: The headline's arrive: opacity 0 to 1 with a 6px rise over 450ms on --fx-ease, once; nothing under reduced motion.

recipe.answer: No exit today: the panel is gone at once.
recipe.proposal: A plain fade over --fx-duration (180ms) with no movement: a page does not perform its exits.

recipe.answer: A hairline spinner with a navy head, a half-radius skeleton, a progress track on the muted stock.
The docket cut; before the footer, the dashed rule.

recipe.situation: Mark what matters in a sentence
recipe.answer: A bronze wash under the phrase, drawn left to right once.

banner.description: A banner that asks for attention, from existing parts only: a card on the page with a masthead line, a Fraunces title, the warning alert whose word 'Warning:' carries the meaning, the navy button with its gold impression beside a ghost button, and the docket cut under it.

Coolant pressure below the floor
